blurb: Guests take guided tours of Niagara Falls, exploring both the American and Canadian sides. Tours include boat rides on the Maid of the Mist, visits to attractions like Cave of the Winds and Skylon Tower, and hotel pickup and dropoff. Private and group tours, as well as airport transportation, are available.
